finding: Explicit resurrection gold restoration shares the corpse item restoration atomic boundary without changing the existing item-only path.
supporting_evidence: Runtime corpse state already owns persisted gold.
Corpse item restoration is owner-restricted and atomic.
The new restoreGold argument is explicit, so unknown Classic gold restoration remains inactive by default.
assumptions: Character lifecycle orchestration decides whether a resurrection restores corpse gold.
safe_fallback: RestoreCorpseItems keeps corpse gold untouched and does not finalize a gold-bearing corpse.
runtime_impact: Adds optional owner-only corpse gold extraction during resurrection restoration.
character_save_impact: The returned gold amount must be applied by Character/Economy orchestration; Items does not mutate character currency directly.
world_state_impact: When explicitly restored, corpse gold becomes zero and an otherwise empty corpse is finalized.
tests: explicit restoration returns all corpse gold
